name: Flockjay
description: Flockjay is an AI-native enablement and coaching platform for revenue teams. This connector brings Flockjay's content, coaching, and training into Claude, so reps and managers can work with them in the flow of a conversation: pull up a battlecard, review coaching on a recent call, check team ramp and training progress, see what's been shared in deal rooms, and take actions like sharing content or assigning training. It supports just-in-time enablement — the right content and coaching at the moment of need — and closed-loop learning that connects calls, scorecards, content, and training. Access is scoped to the signed-in user's Flockjay permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flockjay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flockjay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.flockjay.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flockjay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flockjay lists 22 MCP tools, including assign_content_to_users, create_shared_content, list_assignment_submissions, list_calls, list_learning_content, list_learning_content_progress, list_opportunities, list_scorecard_evaluations, list_shared_content, list_tasks, list_user_certificates, and list_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flockjay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flockjay in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Flockjay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flockjay is developed by Flockjay Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
